evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、apps/daemon/bin/od.mjs、apps/daemon/package.json、apps/daemon/src/agent-protocol/dsh-profile/session.ts、apps/daemon/src/agent-session-resume.ts、apps/daemon/src/artifacts-cli.ts、apps/daemon/src/artifacts/create.ts、apps/daemon/src/artifacts/publication-guard.ts、apps/daemon/src/artifacts/stub-guard.ts、apps/daemon/src/cli.ts、apps/daemon/src/collab/collab-cloud-service.ts、apps/daemon/src/collab/comment-batch-receipt.ts、apps/daemon/src/collab/comment-relay-outbox.ts、apps/daemon/src/collab/vela-cli-collab-client.ts、apps/daemon/src/integrations/collab-cloud.ts、apps/daemon/src/projects.ts、apps/daemon/src/routes/project/comments.ts、apps/daemon/src/routes/project/conversations.ts、apps/daemon/src/routes/project/index.ts、apps/daemon/src/routes/runs.ts、apps/daemon/src/runtimes/agent-process.ts、apps/daemon/src/runtimes/defs/deepseek-harness.ts、apps/daemon/src/runtimes/registry.ts、apps/daemon/src/runtimes/runs.ts、apps/daemon/src/server.ts、apps/web/src/components/DesignFilesPanel.tsx、apps/web/src/components/PreviewModal.tsx、package.json、packages/dsh-runtime/cordis.patch.yml、packages/dsh-runtime/package.json、packages/dsh-runtime/src/index.ts；实际DSH child/profile Agent经ready/session/result到可见事件和close判据；代表create链有manifest/有限marker门，评论经durable outbox单条push及revision ACK。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
limitations: 根/daemon/companion manifest与CLI、DSH registry/实际chat选择/spawn/controller/profile create-resume/事件/result、取消API/协议/进程树和resume恢复关键条件；od artifacts create→本地files API→manifest/guard/stub/write/版本及两个实际iframe；评论route/身份/本地事务→server callback→outbox→单条Vela/HTTP client→revision ACK，批helper仅潜在方法对照。未全审其他Agent真实模型循环、全部Host版本、所有云/MCP/插件/安装器/桌面/媒体/预览和服务端运营；未执行目标。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 为已有编码Agent的设计开发者，把非敏感brief、生成制品、预览和反馈放回同项目接续；根是独立应用，不是DSH根插件。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
实际DSH child/profile Agent经ready/session/result到可见事件和close判据；代表create链有manifest/有限marker门，评论经durable outbox单条push及revision ACK。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。

根/daemon/companion manifest与CLI、DSH registry/实际chat选择/spawn/controller/profile create-resume/事件/result、取消API/协议/进程树和resume恢复关键条件；od artifacts create→本地files API→manifest/guard/stub/write/版本及两个实际iframe；评论route/身份/本地事务→server callback→outbox→单条Vela/HTTP client→revision ACK，批helper仅潜在方法对照。未全审其他Agent真实模型循环、全部Host版本、所有云/MCP/插件/安装器/桌面/媒体/预览和服务端运营；未执行目标。
根open-design与daemon 0.25.1均private、Apache-2.0，根Node ~24、pnpm >=10.33.2 <11；od装载dist，内部可分发DSH runtime 0.1.0另有Node>=24和peer范围。根不是DSH插件；未安装/发布验证，不用README时效促销作现行价格。
构建/Agent/模型与常驻状态、设计人工复核和断流/半写/未知云回执对账分开；用量/超时不是总费用上限，现金/TCO/净工时未测。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。

已有编码Agent/设计系统经验者，仅在独立OS账户或隔离环境的非敏感项目副本，匹配实际CLI/profile/companion且先不启云同步/分享/公网，验证一项本地HTML任务。记录协议max-tokens/自动恢复并读回制品/manifest/版本和人工核brief，取消后另核目标进程、已写文件/外部动作；不把预览沙箱当Agent OS权限。身份、目录、回执/费用或半写状态不明立即停并手工读回/还原副本，生产写/任意后续DSH rc/自动设计合格或全云治理需求先观察。见[Q05](#research-q05)。
源码支持接线/局部门与可靠传输的若干措施，不证明手机/设计合格、全部云送达或净返工减少；协议/写入/ACK/设计验收分开。效果表见[Q05](#research-q05)。
值得复用request/session/seq、缺终态失败、scope/witness和revision ACK；应把协议/进程/文件/云回执/设计验收各自列明，严格helper不替代活动caller与真实服务读回。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
把设计资产/Agent接线、可预览制品及反馈传输组织成同项目交接；身份/缺终态、局部制品门和持久评论修订ACK有实际caller。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
协议completed含max-tokens且不是设计合格；marker/stub局部有限，正文/manifest非原子写。严格批回执不在所核单条drain，Vela单条空输出/缺数字seq可折0而被调用成功ACK，不能推出云落地或意见已落实。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
先修单条回执shape/未知结果读回，再验证评论到制品版本的具体改动证据和人工验收；已有版本/witness/队列不当新量，简单原应用修复/清单够用就否定新插件。见[Q06](#research-q06)。
应用构建/Node24与可用Agent/模型、DSH匹配profile/companion、隔离用户与项目/资产、状态写权限必需；云/Vela/MCP/媒体按选用另审。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)以成熟Agent/设计资产/预览整合为主，novelty小幅9，未到有清晰新方法差异18；[Q02](#research-q02)身份/终态/取消、[Q03](#research-q03)有限门与[Q04](#research-q04)durable revision ACK构成具体局部机制15，超薄包装8，但端到端设计/云回执边界不足23；协议/作用域/条件ACK规则能抽离给其他外部Agent客户端，迁移10超过仅本项目经验5，但强耦合自身profile/状态未到普适15；一工作区减少多处手工交接，简化8超仅安装便利4，仍需版本/资产/权限/恢复人工，未到11。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)和[Q03](#research-q03)把brief、Agent、制品/预览及反馈重新组织交接，workflow18，超仅入口便利9，未证跨团队稳定变革26；[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)manifest/门/持久修订ACK使delivery15，超纯生成展示8，但质量/全部云交付与意见落实未到23；[Q03](#research-q03)可视预览和[Q04](#research-q04)评论入口把结果交给复核者，reach小幅5超只有后台实现0，但主要仍是已有Agent设计开发者，未证实际新客群/新增采用渠道10；复用现有Agent/同项目文件、持久增量队列和413停自动重试安排资源/恢复责任，economics小幅4超无此组织机制0，但本地常驻/云和人工仍重，未到8，TCO/节时未知不作零分或实测收益。

recommendation.reason: 已有编码Agent和设计系统经验的用户，可在独立隔离环境的非敏感项目副本、核真实CLI/profile/companion与模型授权且先不启云分享/同步或公网后，试一项本地HTML任务。它把Agent身份/终态、代表制品门/预览和持久评论意图接进同项目，能减少手工接线，但completed含max-tokens、有限门和ACK都不能替代实际内容/设计/远端读回。身份、目录、回执、费用或半写/取消后的副作用不明就停并手工核对还原副本，生产写、任意后续DSH rc兼容或自动设计合格/全云治理需求先观察。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)已有Agent设计者的一项HTML交付与明确验收，超泛设计便利15；真实需求频次/团队收益未测，未到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)到[Q04](#research-q04)接线、局部门/预览及持久反馈比裸文件/截图基线具体，超简单展示6；设计/全部云/版本权限仍需人工，未到稳定明显优势19。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)实际server/controller/companion与取消callee、[Q03](#research-q03)写门caller、[Q04](#research-q04)真实单条drain和SQL条件及反证超README/helper片段6；无运行/真实设计或服务验收，未到19。

cost.rationale: [Q05](#research-q05)独立无敏感副本、仅本地单任务和人工停进程/还原给可控小样，超0；[Q02](#research-q02)版本/外部Agent权限、[Q03](#research-q03)半写和[Q04](#research-q04)回执未知恢复负担重/TCO未测，未到10。

data.reports:
# Open Design > 独立本地设计应用，把编码Agent、设计资产、项目制品、预览和反馈组织在同一工作区，内含DSH stdio companion。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[nexu-io/open-design](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design) - **版本号**：0.25.1（[固定提交 43792760e07093af7a57a0fdc58a0a424e849f26](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/tree/43792760e07093af7a57a0fdc58a0a424e849f26)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-29（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定根应用及DSH runtime实际选择/spawn/controller/companion、代表本地制品create/guard/写入/预览与评论scope/outbox/单条client/ACK重要支路已核；不是全monorepo/Host/所有云、MCP、安装器和UI审计，未运行。真实entry_type为client。仅建议已有Agent经验者在独立环境、非敏感项目副本、匹配CLI/profile并先不启云/公网的一项HTML小样；生产写、任意DSH版本、全部设计合格或云权限保证先观察。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：为已有编码Agent的设计开发者，把非敏感brief、生成制品、预览和反馈放回同项目接续；根是独立应用，不是DSH根插件。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：把设计资产/Agent接线、可预览制品及反馈传输组织成同项目交接；身份/缺终态、局部制品门和持久评论修订ACK有实际caller。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 - **思考**：协议completed含max-tokens且不是设计合格；marker/stub局部有限，正文/manifest非原子写。严格批回执不在所核单条drain，Vela单条空输出/缺数字seq可折0而被调用成功ACK，不能推出云落地或意见已落实。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 - **建议**：先修单条回执shape/未知结果读回，再验证评论到制品版本的具体改动证据和人工验收；已有版本/witness/队列不当新量，简单原应用修复/清单够用就否定新插件。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 采用建议：已有编码Agent/设计系统经验者，仅在独立OS账户或隔离环境的非敏感项目副本，匹配实际CLI/profile/companion且先不启云同步/分享/公网，验证一项本地HTML任务。记录协议max-tokens/自动恢复并读回制品/manifest/版本和人工核brief，取消后另核目标进程、已写文件/外部动作；不把预览沙箱当Agent OS权限。身份、目录、回执/费用或半写状态不明立即停并手工读回/还原副本，生产写/任意后续DSH rc/自动设计合格或全云治理需求先观察。见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 核心贡献 把设计资产/Agent接线、可预览制品及反馈传输组织成同项目交接；身份/缺终态、局部制品门和持久评论修订ACK有实际caller。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 关键质疑 协议completed含max-tokens且不是设计合格；marker/stub局部有限，正文/manifest非原子写。严格批回执不在所核单条drain，Vela单条空输出/缺数字seq可折0而被调用成功ACK，不能推出云落地或意见已落实。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 先修单条回执shape/未知结果读回，再验证评论到制品版本的具体改动证据和人工验收；已有版本/witness/队列不当新量，简单原应用修复/清单够用就否定新插件。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 后续独立无敏感部署固定brief/模型预算，测真实版本/会话、缺终态/max-tokens/取消进程和副作用、半写/同名/版本/预览、空回执/丢ACK/途中编辑/413及人工意见落实，与原截图反馈比较合格率/遗漏/恢复与费用。 ## 场景与替代办法 为已有编码Agent的设计开发者，把非敏感brief、生成制品、预览和反馈放回同项目接续；根是独立应用，不是DSH根插件。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 对照编辑器/现有Agent生成HTML、文件+截图聊天反馈与人工读回清单；所选模型、Harness工具和云服务/设计资产不全归本应用原创。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 依赖与流程 应用构建/Node24与可用Agent/模型、DSH匹配profile/companion、隔离用户与项目/资产、状态写权限必需；云/Vela/MCP/媒体按选用另审。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。 隔离副本核版本/profile/项目→一项HTML生成→读回文件/manifest/版本并人工预览→取消核进程/文件→保成果再退出；云协作后续另验。含执行者步骤见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 成本与效果 构建/Agent/模型与常驻状态、设计人工复核和断流/半写/未知云回执对账分开；用量/超时不是总费用上限，现金/TCO/净工时未测。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。 源码支持接线/局部门与可靠传输的若干措施，不证明手机/设计合格、全部云送达或净返工减少；协议/写入/ACK/设计验收分开。效果表见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：固定本地DSH接线/制品和评论代表链能支持什么采用，哪些执行/回执状态不能当设计交付？ ### Q01 · 独立应用怎样组织设计交付，哪些能力属于本项？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 本项是独立设计应用/客户端，不是把根包直接安装进DSH的单插件。根open-design与daemon声明0.25.1、private、Apache-2.0，根Node ~24、pnpm >=10.33.2 <11；od命令指向daemon launcher，实际检查dist/cli.js存在后import，缺构建会明确报错。内含可分发@open-design/dsh-runtime 0.1.0作为DSH companion，不把这个内部包版本当整个应用版本，也不将root private误当不可运行。 面向已有编码Agent、需要把非敏感brief做成可预览设计制品并接续修订的设计开发者。作者定位把design systems/skills、生成、项目制品、预览与团队反馈放在同工作区；合格结果应满足brief/设计系统、正确项目/版本、能预览并可继续修改。相对编辑器生成HTML、文件传来传去和截图聊天反馈，潜在增量是交接与状态组织。多模型/制品/模板数量和营销“first”不证明设计合格、真实采用或首创。 本轮代表链实际闭合DSH runtime注册/选择→子进程→stdio controller→本仓库companion→Agent followup/事件/result，并独立核od artifacts create→本地文件API→writeProjectFile及两个实际iframe预览面；评论只核一条本地写+durable outbox→单条Vela/HTTP client→ACK链。不是所有provider、MCP/Skill安装器、桌面发布/云协作后端、全部UI/所有发布入口的全审。DSH实际模型工具循环和CLI权限由所选Harness/用户profile提供，OD主要连接和展示，不把其他Agent/设计系统/云端实现全归本项。 旧正式411162cb1b97ada701a498a1f34b4366cc9898f5四题、证据指向及所有findings/自代码依赖已完整只读。本轮补上旧稿没闭合的活动caller：制品门确实在带有效manifest写入链调用；取消外层也有进程树终止；反而不能从严格batch receipt helper推当前comment drain走批处理。未启动应用/CLI/Agent、未安装/运行测试、未真实模型生成或发布分享。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[package.json:1-14](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/blob/43792760e07093af7a57a0fdc58a0a424e849f26/package.json#L1-L14) 根应用版本/许可/private/od入口。

The `claude` / `codex` / `cursor-agent` / `copilot` / `hermes` / `kimi` already on your `PATH` are the design engine. Swap with one click.\n- 🧠 **Brand-grade by default.** Every render reads the active package's `DESIGN.md` as the core brand contract. 151 design-system packages ship with the repo; legacy packages may be `DESIGN.md`-only, while newer packages can add `manifest.json`, `tokens.css`, components, assets, and provenance. The BYOK proxy includes SSRF safeguards.\n\n---\n\n## Quick start\n\n### 🖥️ Download the desktop app (recommended — zero config)\n\nThe fastest way to use OpenDesign. No Node, no pnpm, no clone.\n\n- **macOS** (Apple Silicon · Intel x64) → [**open-design.ai**](https://open-design.ai/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=readme_download_macos) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases)\n- **Windows** (x64) → [**open-design.ai**](https://open-design.ai/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=readme_download_windows) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases)\n- **Linux** → No prebuilt Linux artifact is currently published in the official releases. For now, [run OpenDesign from source](#-run-from-source); Linux release work is tracked in [#4368](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/issues/4368).\n\nAfter install: the app auto-detects every coding-agent CLI on your `PATH`, loads 100+ functional skills, the separate rendering-template catalog, and 151 design systems, and lets you type a brief in the entry view.\n\n### 🤖 Install into your coding agent (no UI)\n\nYou can use OpenDesign without ever opening the GUI — call it as a skill, plugin, or MCP server inside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, OpenClaw, Antigravity, Hermes, Kimi, and more.\n\nIf you installed the macOS desktop app via the DMG or Homebrew cask, your shell\nmay still resolve `od` to Apple's built-in `/usr/bin/od` octal-dump utility. In\nthat case, open **Settings → MCP server** in the desktop app and copy the\nclient-specific snippet; it uses absolute paths and does not rely on the bare\n`od` command.\n\n```bash\n# One-line install into the agent you're using:\nod mcp install <agent>\n# <agent> = claude | codex | reasonix | raven | cursor | copilot | openclaw\n#         | antigravity | pi | vibe | hermes | cline | kimi | kiro\n#         | trae | opencode\n\n# Hosted equivalent for curl-based setup:\ncurl -fsSL https://open-design.ai/install.sh | sh -s <agent>\n```\n\n`install.sh` is a thin shell wrapper around `od mcp install`; it exists so the\nhosted URL returns shell instead of the landing-page HTML fallback and fails\nfast if your shell resolves a non-Open-Design `od` binary.\n\n> **macOS / WSL2 users:** `/usr/bin/od` is a system octal-dump command and can\n> shadow OpenDesign's `od` command. Desktop-app users should prefer the\n> **Settings → MCP server** snippet; WSL2 users should follow the\n> [`WSL2 setup guide`](docs/wsl-setup.md) first.\n\nThen, inside the agent:\n\n```\n> Use open-design to generate a landing page with the Linear design system\n```\n\nIn a filesystem-backed local CLI run, the agent composes the selected functional skill or design template with your `DESIGN.md`, writes the canonical project files, and OpenDesign previews those files. A BYOK/plain-API run without filesystem tools instead returns one complete `<artifact>` block.\n\n### 🐳 Run with Docker\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design.git\ncd open-design/deploy\ncp .env.example .env\necho \"OD_API_TOKEN=$(openssl rand -hex 32)\" >> .env\ndocker compose up -d\n# open http://127.0.0.1:7456\n```\n\nIf the browser asks for credentials, use `open-design` as the username and the\n`OD_API_TOKEN` value from `deploy/.env` as the password. API clients can keep\nusing `Authorization: Bearer <OD_API_TOKEN>`.\n\n### 🚀 Deploy on Sealos\n\n[![Deploy on Sealos](https://sealos.io/Deploy-on-Sealos.svg)](https://sealos.io/products/app-store/open-design/)\n\nThe Sealos App Store template runs the published OpenDesign Docker image with persistent workspace storage and Basic Auth on the public proxy. Less rework, less drift.\n\n---\n\n## Use OpenDesign from your coding agent\n\nOpenDesign ships a **stdio MCP server** and per-agent **install scripts**. Any MCP-compatible agent in another repo can read files from your local OpenDesign projects directly — tokens CSS, JSX components, entry HTML — as a structured API queryable by name. The agent always sees the live file, not a stale export.\n\n```bash\n# One-line install (16+ CLIs supported):\nod mcp install <agent>\n\n# Then the agent can:\nod project list --json\nod files list <project-id> --json\nod files read <project-id> <relative-path>\nod plugin list --json\nod skills list --json\n```\n\n**Why MCP?** Exporting and re-attaching a zip every iteration breaks flow. MCP exposes the design source directly — the agent always sees the live file.\n\n**For an agent starting from scratch,** the installer places `~/.config/<agent>/open-design.json` (or the platform equivalent) plus a copy-paste MCP snippet. Cursor gets a one-click deeplink; Claude Code gets a `claude mcp add-json` one-liner; every other agent gets JSON in the schema its config expects. On macOS desktop installs, prefer that Settings snippet over typing bare `od mcp install <agent>` in Terminal, because `/usr/bin/od` may win on PATH. Full per-agent flow → **Settings → MCP server** in the desktop app, or [`docs/agent-adapters.md`](docs/agent-adapters.md).\n\n**Security model.** Read-only by default, the daemon binds to `127.0.0.1`, and SSRF is blocked at the proxy edge. LAN exposure requires an explicit `OD_BIND_HOST` plus `OD_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`. Connector credentials and live-artifact preview routes stay loopback-only regardless.\n\n**Internally-hosted model endpoints.** To prevent SSRF, the daemon blocks provider base URLs that resolve to private/internal address ranges (RFC1918, link-local, CGNAT, and cloud-metadata IPs) by default, surfacing `Internal IPs blocked`. If you run an internally-hosted gateway (e.g. LiteLLM or Ollama on a VPN-only `10.x`/`192.168.x` address), opt that host out with `OD_ALLOWED_INTERNAL_HOSTS=<host1>,<host2>,...` — a comma- or whitespace-separated list of bare hostnames or IPs (`10.0.0.5`, `litellm.internal.corp`; a `host:port` or full URL is accepted and reduced to its hostname; IPv6 must be bracketed, e.g. `[fd00::1]`). The allowlist is strict opt-in (empty by default), exact-host (no subdomain/substring matching), and applies **only** to provider endpoints you configure (connection test, model discovery, BYOK chat). It deliberately does **not** relax the guard on download URLs returned inside upstream responses, which stay blocked. A malformed entry — or CIDR notation, which is not supported — is dropped with a warning rather than silently trusted, so a typo never quietly widens (or fails to widen) the guard. Allowlisting a hostname trusts whatever it resolves to (like `OD_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`); allowlist the resolved IP instead if you want the DNS-resolved address re-checked.\n\n---\n\n## Skills and design templates\n\n**100+ functional skills ship in [`skills/`](skills/)**. See [`od-code-migration`](plugins/_official/scenarios/od-code-migration/).\n- 💾 **Persist custom workflows** — your team's reusable templates sit next to the shipped ones.\n\n### Using plugins\n\nPlugins are at full parity across the **web UI** and the **`od` CLI** — same `/api/plugins` endpoints, pick whichever fits.\n\n**In the desktop / web app:** open the **Plugin** page to browse the marketplace and click **Install**; inside a project's Studio, plugins appear as composer chips you click to apply (with the inputs they declare).\n\n**On the command line** (runs without a UI — this is the path external agents use):\n\n```bash\nod plugin list                       # list installed plugins (--task-kind / --mode / --tag filters)\nod plugin search \"landing page\"      # search by keyword\nod plugin info od-default            # inspect a plugin's metadata, inputs, capabilities\nod plugin install od-default        # install from a registry; also accepts ./local-folder or an https://… link\nod plugin apply od-default --input brief=\"a one-page pitch for our seed round\"\nod plugin upgrade od-default         # upgrade\nod plugin uninstall od-default       # uninstall\n```\n\nEvery command supports `--json`, so you can pipe it through `jq` / `xargs` into automation.\n\n### Building a plugin\n\nAn OpenDesign plugin requires `open-design.json` plus the payload required by its type. A workflow skill or scenario also includes `SKILL.md`; manifest-only template and design-system entries use their own payloads instead:\n\n```\nmy-plugin/\n├── open-design.json    ← required: marketplace metadata + inputs + pipeline + capabilities\n├── SKILL.md            ← required for agent-skill/scenario entries; omitted for other plugin types\n├── README.md           ← optional: usage, install, registry links\n├── preview/            ← optional: index.html / poster.png (strongly recommended for visual plugins)\n└── examples/           ← optional: concrete use cases\n```\n\nCore `open-design.json` fields: `specVersion` (currently `1.0.0`), `name` (stable ID), `version` (semver), optional `compat.agentSkills[].path` (points at `./SKILL.md` when the entry exposes an Agent Skill), `od.kind` (`skill` / `scenario` / `atom` / `bundle`), `od.taskKind` (`new-generation` / `figma-migration` / `code-migration` / `tune-collab`), `od.mode` (the output surface, e.g. `prototype` / `deck` / `live-artifact` / `image` / `video` / `hyperframes` / `audio` / `design-system` / `scenario`), `od.capabilities[]` (**declare the minimum** — a restricted install grants only `prompt:inject` by default), `od.inputs[]` (apply-time parameters).\n\nScaffold + validate locally:\n\n```bash\nod plugin scaffold --id my-plugin --title \"My Plugin\"   # generate the skeleton\nod plugin validate ./my-plugin                          # check manifest / file layout\npnpm guard && pnpm --filter @open-design/plugin-runtime typecheck\n```\n\nFull field set and runtime contract → [`plugins/spec/SPEC.md`](plugins/spec/SPEC.md); developing a plugin with a coding agent → [`plugins/spec/AGENT-DEVELOPMENT.md`](plugins/spec/AGENT-DEVELOPMENT.md); copy-paste minimal templates → [`plugins/spec/examples/`](plugins/spec/examples/).\n\n### Contributing a plugin\n\n1. Drop the plugin folder into [`plugins/community/`](plugins/community/) (third-party plugins), or — to ship it bundled with OpenDesign — into the matching tier of [`plugins/_official/`](plugins/_official/).\n2. Pass validation: `od plugin validate`, `pnpm guard`, `pnpm --filter @open-design/plugin-runtime typecheck`.\n3. Fill the PR using the template in [`plugins/spec/CONTRIBUTING.md`](plugins/spec/CONTRIBUTING.md) (ID, version, lane, mode, capabilities, trigger examples; attach a screenshot / preview for visual plugins).\n4. To publish to an external registry (skills.sh / ClawHub / standalone GitHub) → [`plugins/spec/PUBLISHING-REGISTRIES.md`](plugins/spec/PUBLISHING-REGISTRIES.md).\n\nPlugin registry endpoint: `GET /api/plugins`. {} : { status }),\n      error: { message, ...(details === undefined ? {} : { details }) },\n    },\n    process.stderr,\n  );\n  return { exitCode: 1 };\n}\n\nfunction parseOptions(args: string[]): ParsedOptions | { error: string } {\n  const [command, ...rest] = args;\n  const options: ParsedOptions = {\n    command: command === '-h' || command === '--help' ? undefined : command,\n    encoding: 'utf8',\n    help: command === '-h' || command === '--help',\n  };\n\n  for (let index = 0; index < rest.length; index += 1) {\n    const arg = rest[index];\n    if (arg === '--project') {\n      const value = rest[++index];\n      if (!value) return { error: '--project requires a value' };\n      options.project = value;\n    } else if (arg === '--name') {\n      const value = rest[++index];\n      if (!value) return { error: '--name requires a path' };\n      options.name = value;\n    } else if (arg === '--input') {\n      const value = rest[++index];\n      if (!value) return { error: '--input requires a file path' };\n      options.inputPath = value;\n    } else if (arg === '--manifest') {\n      const value = rest[++index];\n      if (!value) return { error: '--manifest requires a file path' };\n      options.manifestPath = value;\n    } else if (arg === '--daemon-url') {\n      const value = rest[++index];\n      if (!value) return { error: '--daemon-url requires a URL' };\n      options.daemonUrl = value;\n    } else if (arg === '--encoding') {\n      const value = rest[++index];\n      if (value !== 'utf8' && value !== 'base64') return { error: '--encoding must be utf8 or base64' };\n      options.encoding = value;\n    } else if (arg === '-h' || arg === '--help') {\n      options.help = true;\n    } else {\n      return { error: `unknown option: ${arg}` };\n    }\n  }\n\n  return options;\n}\n\nasync function readJsonObject(filePath: string): Promise<JsonObject> {\n  const text = await readFile(filePath, 'utf8');\n  let value: unknown;\n  try {\n    value = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;\n  } catch (error) {\n    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n    throw new Error(`invalid JSON in ${filePath}: ${message}`);\n  }\n  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {\n    throw new Error(`${filePath} must contain a JSON object`);\n  }\n  return value as JsonObject;\n}\n\nexport async function runArtifactsCli(args: string[]): Promise<ArtifactCliResult> {\n  const options = parseOptions(args);\n  if ('error' in options) return fail(options.error);\n  if (options.help || !options.command) {\n    process.stdout.write(USAGE);\n    return { exitCode: options.command ? 0 : 1 };\n  }\n  if (options.command !== 'create') return fail(`unknown artifacts command: ${options.command}`);\n  if (!options.name) return fail('create requires --name <path>');\n  if (!options.inputPath) return fail('create requires --input <file>');\n\n  try {\n    const daemonUrl = await resolveDaemonUrl(\n      options.daemonUrl === undefined ? {} : { flagUrl: options.daemonUrl },\n    );\n    const { id, resolved, active } = await resolveProjectArg(daemonUrl, options.project);\n    const fileBuffer = await readFile(options.inputPath);\n    const content = options.encoding === 'base64' ? fileBuffer.toString('base64') : fileBuffer.toString('utf8');\n    const artifactManifest = options.manifestPath === undefined\n      ? undefined\n      : await readJsonObject(options.manifestPath);\n    const response = await postCreateArtifactRequest({\n      baseUrl: daemonUrl,\n      projectId: id,\n      input: {\n        name: options.name,\n        content,\n        encoding: options.encoding,\n        ...(artifactManifest === undefined ? {} : { artifactManifest }),\n      },\n    });\n    const payload = response && typeof response === 'object' && !Array.isArray(response)\n      ? (response as JsonObject)\n      : { result: response };\n    writeJson({ ok: true, ...withActiveEcho(payload, active, resolved) });\n    return { exitCode: 0 };\n  } catch (error) {\n    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n    const details = error && typeof error === 'object' && 'details' in error\n      ? (error as { details?: unknown }).details\n      : undefined;\n    const status = error && typeof error === 'object' && 'status' in error\n      ? (error as { status?: number }).status\n      : undefined;\n    return fail(message, details, status);\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';\nimport { inferLegacyManifest, validateArtifactManifestInput } from './manifest.js';\n\ntype JsonObject = Record<string, unknown>;\n\nexport interface CreateProjectArtifactInput {\n  name: string;\n  content: string;\n  encoding?: 'utf8' | 'base64' | string;\n  artifactManifest?: unknown;\n}\n\nexport interface CreateProjectArtifactOptions {\n  projectsRoot: string;\n  projectId: string;\n  input: CreateProjectArtifactInput;\n  metadata?: unknown;\n  writeProjectFile: (\n    projectsRoot: string,\n    projectId: string,\n    name: string,\n    body: Buffer,\n    options: { overwrite: false; artifactManifest: unknown },\n    metadata?: unknown,\n  ) => Promise<unknown>;\n}\n\nexport class ArtifactManifestRequiredError extends Error {\n  code = 'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST_REQUIRED' as const;\n\n  constructor(name: string) {\n    super(`artifactManifest is required for ${name}; no safe default manifest can be inferred`);\n  }\n}\n\nexport class ArtifactManifestInvalidError extends Error {\n  code = 'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST_INVALID' as const;\n\n  constructor(message: string) {\n    super(`invalid artifactManifest: ${message}`);\n  }\n}\n\nexport function buildCreateArtifactRequestBody(input: CreateProjectArtifactInput): JsonObject {\n  return {\n    name: input.name,\n    content: input.content,\n    encoding: input.encoding === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'utf8',\n    artifact: true,\n    overwrite: false,\n    ...(input.artifactManifest === undefined ? {} : { artifactManifest: input.artifactManifest }),\n  };\n}\n\nexport function resolveCreateArtifactManifest(input: CreateProjectArtifactInput): unknown {\n  const manifest = input.artifactManifest !== undefined && input.artifactManifest !== null\n    ? input.artifactManifest\n    : inferLegacyManifest(input.name);\n  if (manifest) {\n    const validated = validateArtifactManifestInput(manifest, input.name);\n    if (!validated.ok) {\n      throw new ArtifactManifestInvalidError(validated.error);\n    }\n    return validated.value;\n  }\n  throw new ArtifactManifestRequiredError(input.name);\n}\n\nexport async function createProjectArtifactFile(options: CreateProjectArtifactOptions): Promise<unknown> {\n  const { input } = options;\n  const body = input.encoding === 'base64'\n    ? Buffer.from(input.content, 'base64')\n    : Buffer.from(input.content, 'utf8');\n  return await options.writeProjectFile(\n    options.projectsRoot,\n    options.projectId,\n    input.name,\n    body,\n    {\n      overwrite: false,\n      artifactManifest: resolveCreateArtifactManifest(input),\n    },\n    options.metadata,\n  );\n}\n\nexport async function postCreateArtifactRequest(args: {\n  baseUrl: string;\n  projectId: string;\n  input: CreateProjectArtifactInput;\n  headers?: Record<string, string>;\n}): Promise<unknown> {\n  const response = await fetch(\n    `${args.baseUrl.replace(/\\/$/, '')}/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(args.projectId)}/files`,\n    {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: {\n        accept: 'application/json',\n        'content-type': 'application/json',\n        ...args.headers,\n      },\n      body: JSON.stringify(buildCreateArtifactRequestBody(args.input)),\n    },\n  );\n  const text = await response.text();\n  let body: unknown = text;\n  if (text.length > 0) {\n    try {\n      body = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;\n    } catch {\n      body = { message: text };\n    }\n  }\n  if (!response.ok) {\n    const error = new Error(`daemon artifact endpoint failed with ${response.status}`);\n    (error as Error & { details?: unknown; status?: number }).details = body;\n    (error as Error & { status?: number }).status = response.status;\n    throw error;\n  }\n  return body;\n}\n"

      "content": "// Blocks an artifact publication when the body still contains template\n// placeholders that should have been replaced with real content. Scoped to\n// the file-write boundary for HTML-rendered artifact kinds — the moment\n// the file would land in the project as a published artifact — not to the\n// agent's chat prose, where these strings can legitimately appear when\n// the model is asking the user to fill them in.\n//\n// The placeholder set is intentionally short and pitch-deck-specific:\n// these are the exact markers shipped by the official html-ppt-pitch-deck\n// example template that signal \"an unfilled fundraising slot\" rather than\n// \"regular product copy\". Extending the list to more general words risks\n// false positives on real artifacts, so the contract is: any future\n// example that wants similar enforcement should either declare structured\n// `od.inputs` (preferred) or contribute its specific placeholder markers\n// here together with a fixture that proves they cannot appear in\n// finished output.\n//\n// Pairs with `od.inputs` on `plugins/_official/examples/html-ppt-pitch-deck/\n// open-design.json`. The inputs gate is the primary contract — this guard\n// is the defense-in-depth invariant that catches agents that bypassed the\n// structured contract (e.g. routed through `od-default`) but still tried\n// to publish a placeholder-laden HTML/deck artifact.\n\nimport { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';\n\nexport const ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_BLOCKED_CODE = 'ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_BLOCKED' as const;\n\n// HTML and deck are the artifact kinds whose bodies are user-facing\n// rendered documents. Other kinds (markdown drafts, code snippets, raw\n// JSON) are not subject to this guard — placeholder strings can be\n// legitimate content in those.\nexport const PUBLICATION_GUARDED_ARTIFACT_KINDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['html', 'deck']);\n\n// Markers shipped by the html-ppt-pitch-deck example template that\n// indicate an unresolved fundraising slot. Each is a substring; matching\n// is case-sensitive because the template emits these literally.\nexport const UNRESOLVED_ARTIFACT_PLACEHOLDERS = [\n  'Name to confirm',\n  '$X.XM',\n  'Replace this panel with',\n  'Replace role placeholders',\n  'Your form answer only said',\n] as const;\n\nexport class ArtifactPublicationBlockedError extends Error {\n  readonly code = ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_BLOCKED_CODE;\n  readonly placeholders: string[];\n\n  constructor(placeholders: string[]) {\n    super(buildArtifactPublicationBlockedMessage(placeholders));\n    this.name = 'ArtifactPublicationBlockedError';\n    this.placeholders = [...placeholders];\n  }\n}\n\nexport function isPublicationGuardedArtifactKind(kind: unknown): boolean {\n  return typeof kind === 'string' && PUBLICATION_GUARDED_ARTIFACT_KINDS.has(kind);\n}\n\nexport function findUnresolvedArtifactPlaceholders(value: unknown): string[] {\n  const text = stringifyArtifactContent(value);\n  if (!text) return [];\n  return UNRESOLVED_ARTIFACT_PLACEHOLDERS.filter((placeholder) =>\n    text.includes(placeholder),\n  );\n}\n\nexport function shouldBlockArtifactPublication(value: unknown): boolean {\n  return findUnresolvedArtifactPlaceholders(value).length > 0;\n}\n\nexport function buildArtifactPublicationBlockedMessage(placeholders: readonly string[]): string {\n  const list = placeholders.length > 0 ? placeholders.join(', ') : 'unknown placeholders';\n  return `Artifact still contains unresolved pitch-deck placeholders: ${list}. Provide the required pitch facts before publishing.`;\n}\n\nexport function assertArtifactPublicationAllowed(value: unknown): void {\n  const placeholders = findUnresolvedArtifactPlaceholders(value);\n  if (placeholders.length > 0) {\n    throw new ArtifactPublicationBlockedError(placeholders);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction stringifyArtifactContent(value: unknown): string {\n  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;\n  if (Buffer.isBuffer(value)) return value.toString('utf8');\n  if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return Buffer.from(value).toString('utf8');\n  return '';\n}\n"

      "path": "apps/daemon/src/artifacts/stub-guard.ts",
      "content": "// Detects \"stub\" HTML artifact regressions: an agent emits a new artifact\n// with the same metadata.identifier as an earlier one, but the body is a\n// tiny placeholder (\"see <other>.html in this project\", a bare filename\n// string, an empty fallback page, etc.) instead of the full HTML.\n//\n// The guard is structural: it compares the new body's size against the\n// largest prior sibling sharing the same identifier. It does not pattern-\n// match on phrasing, so it works regardless of which agent backend produced\n// the regression. False positives are bounded by minPriorBytes (we won't\n// compare against priors that are themselves small) and minRetainedRatio.\n\nimport type { Dirent } from 'node:fs';\nimport { readFile, readdir, stat } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\nexport type ArtifactStubGuardMode = 'reject' | 'warn' | 'off';\n\nexport interface ArtifactStubGuardConfig {\n  mode: ArtifactStubGuardMode;\n  minRetainedRatio: number;\n  minPriorBytes: number;\n}\n\nexport interface PriorArtifactSibling {\n  name: string;\n  size: number;\n}\n\nexport interface ArtifactStubGuardWarning {\n  code: 'ARTIFACT_REGRESSION';\n  message: string;\n  identifier: string;\n  newSize: number;\n  priorSize: number;\n  priorName: string;\n}\n\nexport interface EvaluateArtifactStubGuardInput {\n  scanDir: string;\n  identifier: string;\n  newSize: number;\n  config: ArtifactStubGuardConfig;\n}\n\nexport interface EvaluateArtifactStubGuardResult {\n  outcome: 'pass' | 'warn' | 'reject';\n  warning?: ArtifactStubGuardWarning;\n}\n\nexport class ArtifactRegressionError extends Error {\n  readonly code = 'ARTIFACT_REGRESSION';\n  readonly identifier: string;\n  readonly newSize: number;\n  readonly priorSize: number;\n  readonly priorName: string;\n\n  constructor(message: string, details: { identifier: string; newSize: number; priorSize: number; priorName: string }) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'ArtifactRegressionError';\n    this.identifier = details.identifier;\n    this.newSize = details.newSize;\n    this.priorSize = details.priorSize;\n    this.priorName = details.priorName;\n  }\n}\n\nexport const DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_STUB_GUARD_CONFIG: ArtifactStubGuardConfig = {\n  mode: 'warn',\n  minRetainedRatio: 0.2,\n  minPriorBytes: 4096,\n};\n\n// HTML-rendered manifest kinds. Decks are HTML files on disk and have the\n// same regression failure mode as plain html artifacts (the agent emits a\n// placeholder where a multi-KB framework should be), so they're guarded\n// alongside `html`.\nexport const STUB_GUARDED_MANIFEST_KINDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['html', 'deck']);\n\nfunction escapeRegExp(value: string): string {\n  return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, '\\\\$&');\n}\n\n// Mirror of the slugifier in `apps/web/src/components/ProjectView.tsx`'s\n// `persistArtifact`. The web path slugifies the identifier for the\n// filename basename but keeps the *raw* identifier in the manifest, so a\n// regex anchored on the raw identifier alone can miss its own slug-form\n// siblings on disk. We try both forms.\nexport function slugifyArtifactIdentifier(value: string): string {\n  return value\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g, '-')\n    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')\n    .slice(0, 60);\n}\n\n// Frontend fallback name used by persistArtifact when the slugified\n// identifier is empty (e.g. all-non-ASCII identifiers like \"测试\" strip to\n// nothing). Without matching against this, sibling discovery would miss\n// the entire \"artifact*.html\" family that such identifiers produce.\nexport const EMPTY_SLUG_FALLBACK_NAME = 'artifact';\n\n// Two identifiers refer to the same artifact lineage when they're\n// literally equal OR one is the canonical slug form of the other (and\n// that slug is non-empty). Slugs alone matching is not enough: the\n// frontend slugifier truncates at 60 chars, so two raw identifiers that\n// only diverge after character 60 (e.g. \"A...A1\" and \"A...A2\", 70 chars\n// each) would otherwise falsely bridge. Requiring one side to *be* the\n// slug form keeps the \"Landing Page\" <-> \"landing-page\" bridge while\n// rejecting truncation-induced collisions. Empty-slug equivalence\n// (e.g. \"测试\" vs \"首页\") is also not treated as a match for the same\n// reason — distinct identifiers can both strip to empty.\nexport function artifactIdentifiersMatch(a: string, b: string): boolean {\n  if (a === b) return true;\n  const slugA = slugifyArtifactIdentifier(a);\n  if (slugA.length === 0) return false;\n  const slugB = slugifyArtifactIdentifier(b);\n  if (slugA !== slugB) return false;\n  return a === slugA || b === slugB;\n}\n\n// Reads the canonical identifier from a sibling's `.artifact.json`\n// sidecar. Returns null when the sidecar is absent, malformed, or\n// missing a string identifier — callers fall back to filename-derived\n// inference for legacy artifacts that pre-date the sidecar era.\nasync function readSidecarIdentifier(scanDir: string, entryName: string): Promise<string | null> {\n  try {\n    const raw = await readFile(path.join(scanDir, `${entryName}.artifact.json`), 'utf8');\n    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { metadata?: { identifier?: unknown } } | null;\n    const id = parsed?.metadata?.identifier;\n    return typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0 ? id : null;\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n// Strips the frontend's `-N` collision suffix and the `.html` / `.htm`\n// extension to recover the per-lineage basename. Used as one of the\n// fallback identifiers for legacy HTML artifacts that don't have a\n// sidecar yet (anything written before the manifest era, or HTML\n// pasted/uploaded outside the artifact-tag flow). `inferLegacyManifest`\n// already treats these as html-kind artifacts elsewhere; we mirror\n// that so the guard doesn't silently let a stub overwrite them.\nconst SYNTHETIC_IDENTIFIER_SUFFIX = /(?:-\\d+)?\\.html?$/;\nconst HTML_EXTENSION = /\\.html?$/;\n\nfunction syntheticIdentifierFromFilename(name: string): string {\n  return name.replace(SYNTHETIC_IDENTIFIER_SUFFIX, '');\n}\n\n// `phase-2.html` is genuinely ambiguous: it could be the identifier\n// `phase` with a `-2` collision suffix, or the standalone identifier\n// `phase-2`. Without a sidecar to disambiguate, both interpretations\n// are valid candidates — the guard accepts the file as a prior if\n// either matches the input identifier. Visible false positives\n// (rejecting a legitimate write the user can override via env) are\n// preferable to silent false negatives (stub bypasses the guard).\nfunction legacyCandidateIdentifiers(filename: string): string[] {\n  const fullBasename = filename.replace(HTML_EXTENSION, '');\n  const stripped = syntheticIdentifierFromFilename(filename);\n  const candidates: string[] = [];\n  if (fullBasename.length > 0) candidates.push(fullBasename);\n  if (stripped.length > 0 && stripped !== fullBasename) candidates.push(stripped);\n  return candidates;\n}\n\n// Finds prior HTML siblings on disk that share an identifier with a\n// newly-written artifact. The frontend's collision-suffixing scheme means\n// related entries match `<identifier>(-\\d+)?\\.html?`. The scan deliberately\n// includes any file at the same path as the new write — when an agent\n// overwrites `dashboard.html` with the same name, the file currently on\n// disk is the prior content (the overwrite happens after this scan).\nexport async function findPriorArtifactSiblings(\n  scanDir: string,\n  identifier: string,\n): Promise<PriorArtifactSibling[]> {\n  if (identifier.length === 0) return [];\n  const tokens = new Set<string>();\n  tokens.add(identifier);\n  const slug = slugifyArtifactIdentifier(identifier);\n  if (slug.length > 0) tokens.add(slug);\n  // When the identifier slugifies to empty (e.g. all-non-ASCII), the web\n  // path falls back to the literal \"artifact\" basename. Match that family\n  // so a later artifact-2.html stub doesn't bypass the prior.\n  else tokens.add(EMPTY_SLUG_FALLBACK_NAME);\n  const alternation = Array.from(tokens, escapeRegExp).join('|');\n  const pattern = new RegExp(`^(?:${alternation})(?:-\\\\d+)?\\\\.html?$`);\n  let entries: Dirent[];\n  try {\n    entries = await readdir(scanDir, { withFileTypes: true });\n  } catch {\n    return [];\n  }\n  const results: PriorArtifactSibling[] = [];\n  for (const entry of entries) {\n    if (!entry.isFile()) continue;\n    if (!pattern.test(entry.name)) continue;\n    // Verify the sibling's canonical identifier matches before treating\n    // it as a prior. Without this check, distinct identifiers that share\n    // a sibling-name namespace (most reachably the empty-slug fallback,\n    // where 测试 and 首页 both land in artifact*.html) would falsely\n    // warn/reject across each other.\n    //\n    // For legacy HTML artifacts without a sidecar (pre-manifest era,\n    // Write-tool, paste-text, manual import), we fall back to filename-\n    // derived candidates. Because a name like `phase-2.html` is\n    // genuinely ambiguous between \"phase + collision suffix -2\" and \"the\n    // standalone identifier phase-2\", we try both interpretations and\n    // accept the file as a prior if either matches. The canonical-form\n    // anchor in artifactIdentifiersMatch still rules out truncation\n    // collisions and empty-slug conflations.\n    const sidecarIdentifier = await readSidecarIdentifier(scanDir, entry.name);\n    const candidateIdentifiers = sidecarIdentifier !== null\n      ? [sidecarIdentifier]\n      : legacyCandidateIdentifiers(entry.name);\n    if (candidateIdentifiers.length === 0) continue;\n    if (!candidateIdentifiers.some((c) => artifactIdentifiersMatch(identifier, c))) continue;\n    try {\n      const st = await stat(path.join(scanDir, entry.name));\n      results.push({ name: entry.name, size: st.size });\n    } catch {\n      // ignore unreadable entries; they don't influence the guard decision\n    }\n  }\n  return results;\n}\n\nexport function readArtifactStubGuardConfigFromEnv(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): ArtifactStubGuardConfig {\n  const rawMode = (env.OD_ARTIFACT_STUB_GUARD ?? '').toLowerCase();\n  const mode: ArtifactStubGuardMode =\n    rawMode === 'reject' || rawMode === 'warn' || rawMode === 'off'\n      ? rawMode\n      : DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_STUB_GUARD_CONFIG.mode;\n\n  const ratioRaw = Number(env.OD_ARTIFACT_STUB_GUARD_MIN_RATIO);\n  // Accept (0, 1] so users can set 1 to reject any shrinkage. Values <=0\n  // or >1 fall back to default.\n  const minRetainedRatio =\n    Number.isFinite(ratioRaw) && ratioRaw > 0 && ratioRaw <= 1\n      ? ratioRaw\n      : DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_STUB_GUARD_CONFIG.minRetainedRatio;\n\n  const minPriorBytesRaw = Number(env.OD_ARTIFACT_STUB_GUARD_MIN_PRIOR_BYTES);\n  const minPriorBytes =\n    Number.isInteger(minPriorBytesRaw) && minPriorBytesRaw > 0\n      ? minPriorBytesRaw\n      : DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_STUB_GUARD_CONFIG.minPriorBytes;\n\n  return { mode, minRetainedRatio, minPriorBytes };\n}\n\nfunction buildWarning(\n  identifier: string,\n  newSize: number,\n  prior: PriorArtifactSibling,\n): ArtifactStubGuardWarning {\n  return {\n    code: 'ARTIFACT_REGRESSION',\n    message:\n      `New artifact body for identifier \"${identifier}\" is ${newSize} bytes, ` +\n      `but the largest prior sibling \"${prior.name}\" is ${prior.size} bytes. ` +\n      'This pattern usually means the agent emitted a placeholder instead of the full document. ' +\n      'Set OD_ARTIFACT_STUB_GUARD=warn to record the warning without rejecting, or =off to disable the guard entirely.',\n    identifier,\n    newSize,\n    priorSize: prior.size,\n    priorName: prior.name,\n  };\n}\n\n// Pure decision function: given the prior siblings on disk, decide whether\n// the new body is a stub regression. Splitting this from the disk scan\n// keeps the unit tests fast and lets callers pre-fetch siblings.\nexport function classifyArtifactStubGuard(\n  priors: PriorArtifactSibling[],\n  identifier: string,\n  newSize: number,\n  config: ArtifactStubGuardConfig,\n): EvaluateArtifactStubGuardResult {\n  if (config.mode === 'off') return { outcome: 'pass' };\n  if (identifier.length === 0) return { outcome: 'pass' };\n  if (priors.length === 0) return { outcome: 'pass' };\n\n  let largest: PriorArtifactSibling | null = null;\n  for (const prior of priors) {\n    if (largest === null || prior.size > largest.size) largest = prior;\n  }\n  if (largest === null) return { outcome: 'pass' };\n  if (largest.size < config.minPriorBytes) return { outcome: 'pass' };\n\n  const threshold = largest.size * config.minRetainedRatio;\n  if (newSize >= threshold) return { outcome: 'pass' };\n\n  const warning = buildWarning(identifier, newSize, largest);\n  return { outcome: config.mode === 'reject' ? 'reject' : 'warn', warning };\n}\n\nexport async function evaluateArtifactStubGuard(\n  input: EvaluateArtifactStubGuardInput,\n): Promise<EvaluateArtifactStubGuardResult> {\n  if (input.config.mode === 'off') return { outcome: 'pass' };\n  if (input.identifier.length === 0) return { outcome: 'pass' };\n  const priors = await findPriorArtifactSiblings(input.scanDir, input.identifier);\n  return classifyArtifactStubGuard(priors, input.identifier, input.newSize, input.config);\n}\n"

      "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n// @ts-nocheck\nimport { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { basename } from 'node:path';\nimport { runDaemonCliStartup, startDaemonRuntime }       "content": "import { COMMENT_BATCH_MAX_ITEMS, type CommentBatchPushRequest, type CommentBatchPushResponse } from '@open-design/contracts';\n\n/** Validate the whole receipt before any caller may acknowledge individual rows. */\nexport function parseCommentBatchReceipt(stdout: string, request: CommentBatchPushRequest): CommentBatchPushResponse {\n  let value: unknown;\n  try { value = JSON.parse(stdout); } catch { throw new Error('Invalid comment batch receipt'); }\n  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || !('results' in value) || !Array.isArray(value.results)) throw new Error('Invalid comment batch receipt');\n  const remaining = new Set(request.comments.map(item => item.key));\n  const results: CommentBatchPushResponse['results'][number][] = [];\n  for (const item of value.results) {\n    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object' || typeof item.key !== 'string' || !remaining.delete(item.key)\n      || typeof item.ok !== 'boolean'\n      || (item.error !== undefined && typeof item.error !== 'string')\n      || (item.errorCode !== undefined && typeof item.errorCode !== 'string')\n      || (item.status !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(item.status) || item.status < 400 || item.status > 599))\n      || (item.ok && (item.error !== undefined || item.errorCode !== undefined || item.status !== undefined))) {\n      throw new Error('Invalid comment batch receipt');\n    }\n    results.push({ key: item.key, ok: item.ok,\n      ...(item.error !== undefined ? { error: item.error } : {}),\n      ...(item.errorCode !== undefined ? { errorCode: item.errorCode } : {}),\n      ...(item.status !== undefined ? { status: item.status } : {}) });\n  }\n  if (remaining.size) throw new Error('Incomplete comment batch receipt');\n  return { results };\n}\n\nexport function validateCommentBatchRequest(request: CommentBatchPushRequest): void {\n  if (!Array.isArray(request.comments) || request.comments.length < 1 || request.comments.length > COMMENT_BATCH_MAX_ITEMS) throw new Error('Invalid comment batch size');\n  const keys = new Set<string>();\n  for (const item of request.comments) {\n    if (!item || typeof item.key !== 'string' || !item.key.trim() || keys.has(item.key)\n      || typeof item.idempotencyKey !== 'string' || !item.idempotencyKey.trim()) throw new Error('Invalid comment batch identity');\n    keys.add(item.key);\n  }\n}\n"
